name: Bonaventure
epithet: General and right hand to Queen Theodora
personality: Wise royal counsellor who loves philosophy, poetry and cooking.
story: He has advised the Saraminian crown since King Sergio's reign and serves as the kingdom's living memory of history, since Saramis forbids written language. He joins automatically on Theodora's route and cannot be recruited on Cai, Dietrich or Leda routes.

personalSkill.name: Sage Advice
personalSkill.effect: Def+3 to adjacent allies. Lv20: Additional Intel (30% chance of Hit+10 to adjacent allies in combat); Lv35: Hit+20.

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics A; KeenGamer B (support unit). Reddit: Ovate with a Levin Sword hits very hard but is fragile; Spd falls off in Part III for some (disputed).

why: Joins Theodora's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

build.role: Support caster: Hit aura for the axe users, second healer, battalion carrier #3
build.part1Target: Ovate (Bind Dexterity mastered, Black Magic B)
build.notes: Shaman from Ch 6 to Lv 35 keeps doubled Black Magic and Mag 60 growth while he escorts the axe users; Arena Mage covers Black and White Magic B. Part II Bishop banks Barrier, which stacks with Sage Advice on the unit beside him. Sirocco is the main nuke from Ch 7.

guide.role: Support caster: Hit aura for the axe users, second healer, third battalion carrier
guide.summary: The Fortress's support caster and backup healer. End him beside Theodora, Ninae or Tobias: Def +3 always (Sage Advice) and [[ability:Additional Intel]] Hit +10 to +20 (30%). Then cast at range 1-2 or heal.
guide.playstyle: Support first, damage second. He stands at the front for the aura, so keep a Concoction and an escape tile. From Ch 9 Swarm Z slows the target so Tobias doubles it or isn't doubled; from Ch 11 Banshee pins a boss at range 3.
keys: Move him first: end beside Theodora, Ninae or Tobias. Def +3, Hit +10 (30%), +20 at Lv 35.
Train in Arena Mage most weeks: Black Magic B by Lv 35, White Magic B for Part II.
Stay [[class:Shaman]] from Ch 6 to Lv 35: doubled Black Magic, Mag 60 growth.
Read Archives Z (Ch 9), T (Vandahl) and θ (Ch 11) on him: no slot used.
Take [[class:Bishop]] in Part II Ch 1 for Barrier, then Ovate again by Ch 3.
Keep the [[item:Magic Staff]] on; off only when it costs a follow-up.
watch: HP: 35 growth, Def 20 in Shaman. He stands next to the front: carry a Concoction.
Weight: Blizzard 6 + Magic Staff 3 = 9; Cutting Gale 8 + 3 = 11. Staff off when it costs a follow-up.
Part III weight: Salamander +3 3 + Magic Staff 3 = 6 (Levin Sword +2: 11); Fimbulvetr 28 + 3 = 31: one cast, no double.
Dark spells: Swarm 21, Banshee 23, Dark Spikes 20 Wt. He never doubles with them.
Inventory: 3/6 (Salamander, Magic Staff, Concoction). Open slots hold Antitoxin or Pure Water.

guide.alt: Bishop as his main class from Lv 35 if Sofia goes down: doubled Recover, but his White list has no Physic.

routeNotes.note: Theodora, Tobias, Lilian and Lysander in this army (Nydine on the bench). Meal seat: Theodora + Tobias + Bonaventure, where all three pairs gain. Mage Training beside Theodora adds Support too.

Third carrier: [[battalion:Priest Trainees]] (Ch 5), [[battalion:Pure Priests]] (Ch 6, D?), [[battalion:Elevated Priests]] at Authority C (Ch 10). Arena Mage raises Authority with no extra seat; Tactics Manuals go to Theodora.
Lend Strength (D), Lend Dexterity (C), Lend Strength+ (B), Lend Dexterity+ (A): one more Hit tool for the axe user he escorts. How Authority arts fire in battle is not documented.

decisions.pick: Shaman from Ch 6 to the Ovate exam
decisions.why: Priest would only chase White Magic B, which Arena Mage reaches, and it stops his doubled Black Magic for two chapters. Shaman keeps Mag 60 growth and doubled casts while he escorts Tobias.

decisions.topic: Take Bishop in Part II for Barrier
decisions.pick: Bishop in Part II Ch 1 to 2, Ovate again for Ch 3
decisions.why: Barrier (Res +3 to adjacent allies) stacks with Sage Advice on the unit he already stands beside, for the rest of the game. Part II gives 5 Advanced Licenses a chapter.
decisions.else: White Magic short of B: skip the detour

decisions.pick: Ovate at Lv 35, Druid in Part III
decisions.why: Mag +20 and doubled Black Magic: Part II is full of heavy armor. His White list has no Physic, so Sofia and Theodora stay the healers.
